description: This file contains unit tests for various utility functions related to logic hooks in the SuiteCRM project. It tests functions like get_hook_array, check_existing_element, replace_or_add_logic_type, write_logic_file, and build_logic_file, ensuring they handle hook arrays, file writing, and file content generation correctly.

classes.name: logic_utilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing utility functions in SuiteCRM related to logic hooks.

methods.name: testget_hook_array
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the hook array for a valid module and invalid module, verifying array return and exception handling.

methods.name: check_existing_elementProvider
methods.description: Provides test cases for checking the existence of specific hook actions within the hook array.

methods.name: testcheck_existing_element
methods.description: Tests whether specific hook action arrays exist within the hook array, matching expected boolean results.

methods.name: testreplace_or_add_logic_type
methods.description: Verifies that the replace_or_add_logic_type function correctly produces the expected PHP hook array string.

methods.name: testwrite_logic_file
methods.description: Tests writing of the logic hooks PHP file, its existence, and correctness of contents, then cleans up the test file.

methods.name: testbuild_logic_file
methods.description: Checks that build_logic_file generates the correct PHP code string from a given hook array.
